observations.caveat:
The research universe was the population of injecting drug users in Bucharest-Ilfov, aged 18-64 years, and the sample was 530 questionnaires and 34 tested.
The criteria for inclusion of cases in the sample were: to have been an injecting drug user in the last 12 months, aged between 18-64 years, to have the mental and physical ability to understand the questions and instructions, to provide written consent to participate in the study and to have lived in Bucharest - Ilfov for at least 6 months out of the 12 months prior to the interview date.
